summary_for_children: Al-Qari'ah describes the Day in words: people like scattered moths and mountains like fluffed wool. Heavy good deeds bring a pleasing life.
environment_concept: A symbolic world of the surah's two images: scattered moths and fluffed wool, shown as soft abstraction only.
architecture_and_scenery: Abstract field of moths in light, and wool-like clouds.

activities.name: Heavy scales
activities.description: Add good deeds to the scale (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
